- memory_id "1000438" [decision]: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-05-20, when ownership passed from Cinder.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, indexer)

- memory_id "1000388": Marcus has the pager rotation for the Boreal team as of 2025-05-07, taking over from Lena.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000378": The Cinder team reported on 2025-04-24 that feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: Cinder, feature-flags, Tuesday's deploy)

- memory_id "1000351" [decision]: The product catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table, because the joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000339": The product catalog calls the image resizer for thumbnails, so the image resizer is a hard dependency of the product catalog.  (about: product catalog, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000281" [decision]: The Ember team owns the image resizer as of 2025-03-20.  (about: Ember team, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000278" [constraint]: The product catalog can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000158": The indexer depends on the product catalog for product documents.  (about: product catalog, indexer)
- memory_id "1000112": Cinder owns the product catalog.  (about: Cinder, product catalog)
- memory_id "1000105": Oskar takes the first on-call shift of the year for the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000085": Diego is on call for Cinder to start the year.  (about: Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000026": Diego is on Cinder.  (about: Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000021": Yuki Tanaka is on Cinder.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder)
